sources.title: HarmonyOS business-module model and API boundary approved in task context
claims: The business module models directory owns request classes, response classes, other entities, enums and additional pure data definitions.
Request and response model subdirectories may be created below models for their corresponding classes.
The business api directory contains XxxApi.ets, XxxHttpService.ets, XxxHttpRepositoryImpl.ets and repository/IXxxHttpRepository.ets.
The business-module network convention removes the local transport directory and its NetworkRequest, NetworkResult and NetworkError definitions.
Update the Domain rules before applying the policy to a product project.

sources.title: CatchPet HarmonyOS account business-module API structure
claims: The account api directory separates AccountApi endpoint constants, IAccountHttpRepository, AccountHttpRepositoryImpl and AccountHttpService.
The repository interface and implementation import request and response-related types from the module models boundary.
The module consumes an exported common_app httpCall capability instead of declaring a business-owned transport directory.

The current AccountModels.ets combines request, response, entity, enum and state definitions, so it is structural evidence for API responsibilities rather than proof of the new request/response subdirectory outcome.
The platform/HuaweiAccountKitAdapter file is a platform account-capability concern and is not authority for the business HTTP API structure.
